version: LOCK 81 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - The House of Learning, Copying
builds_on: LOCK 2 prayer, LOCK 3 Idris, LOCK 6 regulars, LOCK 34 runner. Private counters go to the Journal; worship never earns trust.

goals.label: Pages copied at the House of Learning

a.text: Past the central square, the House of Learning: rooms full of scholars, translators and copyists bent over desks. The librarian looks at your hands. “Waraka paper on your fingers. Can you copy neatly? We pay six coins a page.”
You copy a page of a book on the stars, checking every word against the original twice.
